root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'QuaffeeLoversEnabled') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl ADD QuaffeeLoversEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSettings_QuaffeeLoversEnabled DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'QuaffeeLoversOrderThreshold') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl ADD QuaffeeLoversOrderThreshold INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSettings_QuaffeeLoversThreshold DEFAULT (3); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'QuaffeeLoversWooRole') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl ADD QuaffeeLoversWooRole NVARCHAR(64) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'QuaffeeLoversWooRole') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl WHERE SettingsID = 1 AND QuaffeeLoversWooRole IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(QuaffeeLoversWooRole)) <> N'') BEGIN UPDATE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl SET QuaffeeLoversWooRole = N'member' WHERE SettingsID = 1; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'WooOrderCount') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooContactInfoTbl ADD WooOrderCount INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooContactInfo_WooOrderCount DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'QuaffeeLoversMember') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooContactInfoTbl ADD QuaffeeLoversMember BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooContactInfo_QuaffeeLovers DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'QuaffeeLoversCheckedUtc') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooContactInfoTbl ADD QuaffeeLoversCheckedUtc DATETIME2 NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.QuaffeeLoversGrantTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.QuaffeeLoversGrantTbl ( GrantID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_QuaffeeLoversGrantTbl PRIMARY KEY, ContactID BIGINT NOT NULL, WooCustomerId BIGINT NULL, MatchEmail NVARCHAR(255) NULL, WooOrderCount INT NOT NULL, WooRoleAtGrant NVARCHAR(64) NULL, AlreadyMemberOnWoo BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_QuaffeeLovers_AlreadyMember DEFAULT (0), RoleGrantedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, WelcomeEmailSentUtc DATETIME2 NULL, RecordedUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_QuaffeeLovers_Recorded DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), RecordedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL, InviteSentUtc DATETIME2 NULL, InviteSentBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL, DismissedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, DismissedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Notes NVARCHAR(500) NULL ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_QuaffeeLoversGrant_Contact ON dbo.QuaffeeLoversGrantTbl (ContactID); END
